# vendor

- `open-claude-in-chrome/`: Open Claude in Chrome by Sebastian Sosa / noemica, PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 (see its LICENSE file). Upstream is https://github.com/noemica-io/open-claude-in-chrome.

    git submodule update --init
